_meta.purpose: Structured transcription of the supplied screenshot evidence.
_meta.method: Manual read of each PNG at full resolution during development. No OCR engine is bundled with the runtime, so the transcribed facts are cached here and loaded deterministically at audit time.
_meta.provenance: Every fact keeps the manifest file_id as its evidence reference. Nothing in this file contains organizer-only truth, expected deltas, or case ids.
_meta.contract: Keys are file_id values from dataset/evidence_files.csv. Each record mirrors the fields a parser would extract from the rendered UI: system, resource id, data category, observed state and the identifiers shown on screen.
